usageNotes: Starts a stopped or suspended LXC container on the specified node. Returns a task UPID string — poll the task status endpoint to confirm the container reached the running state before issuing dependent operations. The caller must hold VM.PowerMgmt on /vms/{vmid} and the target node must be online and have the container's rootfs storage accessible.
tips: The returned UPID can be tracked via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to detect startup errors (e.g. missing network bridge, storage offline).
Use debug: true only for troubleshooting startup failures — it floods the container log and should not be left enabled in production.
skiplock bypasses any administrative lock set on the container (e.g. backup lock); only root may use it, and doing so during an active backup can corrupt the snapshot.
